title: onboard-sable-13b-v1.0-performance-metadata-and-automate-changelog
author: Priya Shah
description: Onboard 'sable-13b' v1.0 into the model registry with complete metadata, performance profiles, and integrate it with the changelog/release notes automation. Motivation: Sable-13b is a community model that matches several of our target workloads with good token throughput and cost characteristics. Customers requested this model in the hosted catalog (see ENG-3542). This PR includes: 1) canonical metadata (author, license, tokenizer, architecture tags, recommended quantization profiles), 2) measured performance profiles for common sequence lengths and hardware classes, 3) a small compatibility shim to ensure model aliases (sable-13b, sable-13b-v1) map correctly, and 4) wiring into the changelog generator so onboarding produces an entry automatically when merged. Implementation notes: - metadata placed at models/sable/metadata.json; follows existing registry schema. - perf profiles under perf_profiles/sable-13b-v1.0.yaml with measured p50/p95 latency and throughput for GPU and CPU quantized variants. - added unit/integration tests to validate metadata schema and perf profile parsing. - extended scripts/changelog_generator.py to detect new model metadata and emit a draft release note entry under changelog/drafts/. Checklist: [x] metadata schema validated by tests, [x] perf measurements validated and reproducible, [x] changelog automation unit tests added, [x] reviewers approved, [x] CI green. Migration/compatibility: no breaking changes to registry schema; aliases are additive. Rollout: already added to the staging catalog pipeline; will be included in next hosted catalog release once this PR is merged.
